info.title: IPTV Player
info.author: muratgokce
info.description: Live TV, movies and series from IPTV
info.details:
IPTV Player plays the live channels, movies and series of your own IPTV subscription: Xtream Codes API accounts and M3U / M3U8 playlists. It does not come with any channels, playlists or accounts.

A fork of TsVitch (giovannimirulla) with the Xtream movies and series work of ratk. It adds:
- Detail pages for movies and series with plot, cast, backdrop and resume
- Seasons and episodes with stills and progress, the next episode after a countdown
- Poster grids with ratings and years, sorting and search
- Now / next programme guide in the player
- Audio and subtitle tracks, subtitle styles, 10-second skips with the D-pad
- Downloads with pause and resume, watched without internet
- Lists saved on the SD card, refreshed every day, every week or only by hand
- English, Turkish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese

Files: sdmc:/switch/iptv-player/. The settings, favorites and history of TsVitch are copied at the first start. Use it only with services and content you are allowed to watch.
